Trump said it himself: He doesn’t think about Americans’ financial situation.

Whether it’s grocery prices or ticket sales, this administration is letting monopolies run unchecked — meaning prices go up for you.

Video
In fact, in 2025, 13 of the top 15 offices with the highest staff turnover were GOP.  Wonder why he’s not running that story instead?

Jason Rantz has sadly turned into part of the Trump cult of MAGA apologists who will do anything for clicks.  He reprised an old story to attack me with cherry-picked data, ignoring the fact that from 2022-25, my office was not even in the top 250 in Congress for staff leaving.

The Live Nation-Ticketmaster merger monopolized live events, making it harder for all Americans to see their favorite band or singer.

Here’s the facts about how Trump pressured the DOJ to settle a lawsuit against their anti-competitive practices.

Video

I am devastated to see the news of this deadly attack on a mosque in San Diego. Our places of worship should be safe spaces for all people. We must all stand up and condemn this attack and all forms of Islamophobia, racism, and hatred that are on the rise in our communities.


The Associated Press (@AP)

Live Nation/Ticketmaster has been ripping off customers and consolidating the ticket market for too long. We’re holding them accountable and fighting back against this corruption and consolidation.

TUNE IN LIVE: nitter.net/i/broadcasts/1NGaragDN…

Wall Street and private equity have no business in kids' sports.

That’s why the @MonopolyBusters Caucus co-chairs are introducing the Let Kids Play Act.

Read more here: usatoday.com/story/sports/20…

Trump’s China summit was just a big show of pomp and circumstance.

Video

Donald Trump now wants a $1.7 BILLION slush fund to pay the January 6 insurrectionists and his MAGA allies.

This is an incredible level of corruption that YOU, the taxpayer, would be paying for.

Video

All signs are pointing in the direction that Trump will follow through on his threat to "take" Cuba, as the country has run out of fuel, and the humanitarian crisis grows worse.

In Congress, we must urgently pass my legislation to stop Trump from using federal funding for military action in Cuba.

Video

This week, I spoke at @MPAC_National and @CSID_DC’s 24th Annual Conference about the need to protect democracy at home and abroad.

As Republicans in Congress continue to attack our Muslim neighbors, this conversation could not have come at a more important time.

There have been 10,000 rulings against Trump’s mass deportation agenda.

ICE is not above the law — and the courts have reaffirmed that in nearly 90% of cases.

Republicans want to force local and state law enforcement to comply with federal mass deportation policies by threatening to cut off billions in funding.

This will NOT work and is a dangerous threat.

Video

As the Pentagon continues an illegal war that has killed thousands of civilians and wasted billions of taxpayer dollars, I will absolutely NOT be voting for any new funding package.

We must continue to introduce War Power Resolutions until we can stop this war.

Video
You can read more about this tragic story here: washingtonpost.com/immigrati…

A devastating story has come out about a US citizen child, Orlin, who was murdered after ICE deported his mom.

This tragedy is an abject failure by ICE, and it’s why I will not give them another cent.

We must stop the cruelty and lawlessness of this administration.

Video

Marco Rubio is going to say whatever pleases Donald Trump.

But the American people heard it for themselves: Trump does not care about your financial situation.

Video

As a member of Congress, I have a duty to meet with people about the impact of US foreign policies.

No amount of right-wing attacks will deter me from working to end the US blockade and humanitarian crisis in Cuba. We need real negotiations between our countries.
